description:
Job Title: UX Developer
Duration - 12 Months + Possible extension
Location- Austin, TX 78759 
 

 

 Description 
 

 • UX expertise required : System Design, Aesthetics
 

 • Expertise in implementing System design patterns
 

 • Good experience in JavaScript and coding in CSS
 

 • Angular 2.0 is a big plus
 

 • Design Patterns – big plus
 

 • Not following procedural programming – but more towards implementing design patterns
 

 • Stronger on Design aspect – HTML, CSS 
 

 • Sense of Design Patterns – OOP / OOC (Not Singleton, go deeper than that)
 

 • Knowledge or experience JAWS screen reader – to address \ troubleshoot \ incorporate ‘Accessibility’ functions 
 

 • Responsive design – another required skillset 
 

 • Enterprise level experience
 

 Additional Job Details: c#, js/angular, html, css in enterprise setting
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
